title: Festive Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry with a variety of spices and a festive twist. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and stir-fry until they are tender.
Add the allspice and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and stir-fry until it is golden brown.
Add the soy sauce and festive spices and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with stir-fry sauce or sesame seeds if desired.
